/* ==========================================================
   Joinchat Tooltip List
   Añadir clase al widget Elementor: joinchat-tooltip-list
   ========================================================== */

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-widget-container,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-items {
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item {
    position: relative;
}

/* Alineación del texto, iconos inline e icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text img {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Botón del icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    min-width: 16px;

    margin-left: 4px;
    padding: 0;

    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: #1e1e1e;

    cursor: help;
    line-height: 1;
    appearance: none;

    opacity: 0.65;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg {
    display: block;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg [fill] {
    fill: currentColor;
}

/* Estado focus accesible */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid currentColor;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Tooltip centrado respecto al icono */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    bottom: calc(100% + 9px);

    width: max-content;
    max-width: min(230px, 85vw);

    background: #1e1e1e;
    color: #ffffff;

    padding: 7px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-align: left;

    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);

    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;

    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);
    transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        transform 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s ease;

    z-index: 9999;
    white-space: normal;
}

/* Flechita centrada */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    top: 100%;

    transform: translateX(-50%);

    border-width: 6px 6px 0 6px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #1e1e1e transparent transparent transparent;
}

/* Mostrar en escritorio con hover/focus y en móvil con clase JS */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 1 activa
   Tooltip más estrecho, más alto si lo necesita,
   manteniendo posición relativa al icono
   ========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
        width: 220px;
        max-width: 70vw;
        min-height: 52px;

        padding: 9px 11px;

        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;

        white-space: normal;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 2 alternativa
   Usar solo si en móvil el tooltip se sigue saliendo
   por estar el icono demasiado cerca del borde.

   Para activarla:
   1. Descomenta este bloque.
   2. Comenta o elimina la Variante móvil 1 anterior.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const minInstalaciones = 739456;
    const maxInstalaciones = 748204;

    // Fecha actual en UTC (timezone 0)
    const fechaHoy = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // Genera una cifra reproducible para cada día
    let hash = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < fechaHoy.length; i++) {
        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + fechaHoy.charCodeAt(i);
        hash |= 0;
    }

    const rango = maxInstalaciones - minInstalaciones + 1;

    const instalacionesActuales =
        minInstalaciones + (Math.abs(hash) % rango);

    // Actualiza todos los elementos con class="activeinstalls"
    document
        .querySelectorAll('.activeinstalls')
        .forEach(function(el) {
            el.innerText =
                instalacionesActuales.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        });

    // Contador principal animado
    const elSpan = document.getElementById('instalaciones');

    if (!elSpan) return;

    let instalacionesMostradas = 0;

    function actualizarInstalaciones() {
        const incremento = Math.ceil(instalacionesActuales / 100);

        if (instalacionesMostradas < instalacionesActuales) {
            instalacionesMostradas = Math.min(
                instalacionesMostradas + incremento,
                instalacionesActuales
            );

            elSpan.innerText =
                instalacionesMostradas.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        } else {
            clearInterval(animarInstalaciones);
        }
    }

    const animarInstalaciones =
        setInterval(actualizarInstalaciones, 20);
});
</script>
<script>
(() => {
 'use strict';

 function init() {
 const counterEl = document.getElementById('counter');
 if (!counterEl) return;

 const BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND = (793566 * 6) / 86400;
 const STORAGE_KEY = 'joinchat_counter_data';
 const SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS = 10;

 const TIME_MULTIPLIERS = [
 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3,
 0.8, 0.8, 0.8,
 1.3, 1.3, 1.3,
 1.2, 1.2,
 0.9, 0.9, 0.9,
 1.4, 1.4, 1.4,
 1.1, 1.1,
 0.6, 0.6
 ];

 let strip = '';
 for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++)
 for (let d = 0; d < 10; d++)
 strip += '<span class="digit-inner">' + d + '</span>';
 const DIGIT_STRIP = strip;

 let currentValue = 0;
 let lastFormatted = '';
 let digitElements = null;
 let saveTickCounter = 0;
 let cachedMidnight = 0;
 let cachedMidnightDay = -1;

 function getMidnightUTC() {
 const now = new Date();
 const day = now.getUTCDate();
 if (day !== cachedMidnightDay) {
 cachedMidnight = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), day);
 cachedMidnightDay = day;
 }
 return cachedMidnight;
 }

 function secondsSinceMidnight() {
 return (Date.now() - getMidnightUTC()) / 1000 | 0;
 }

 function clicksAtSecond(s) {
 const h = (s / 3600) | 0;
 const base = BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND * TIME_MULTIPLIERS[h];
 const x = Math.sin(s) * 10000;
 const noise = x - Math.floor(x);
 const v = base + (noise - 0.5) * 0.6 * base;
 return v < 0 ? 0 : v;
 }

 function accumulatedClicks(seconds) {
 let total = 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < seconds; i++) total += clicksAtSecond(i);
 return total;
 }

 function load() {
 const midnight = getMidnightUTC();
 const now = Date.now();
 const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

 if (stored) {
 try {
 const d = JSON.parse(stored);
 if (d.midnightTimestamp === midnight) {
 currentValue = d.value;
 const elapsed = ((now - d.lastUpdateTime) / 1000) | 0;
 if (elapsed> 0) {
 const start = ((d.lastUpdateTime - midnight) / 1000) | 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < elapsed; i++) currentValue += clicksAtSecond(start + i);
 }
 save();
 return;
 }
 } catch (_) {}
 }

 currentValue = accumulatedClicks(secondsSinceMidnight());
 save();
 }

 function save() {
 localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
 value: currentValue,
 lastUpdateTime: Date.now(),
 midnightTimestamp: getMidnightUTC()
 }));
 }

 function format(n) {
 return Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('es-ES');
 }

 function buildHTML(value) {
 let html = '';
 for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
 const c = value[i];
 html += (c === ',' || c === '.')
 ? '<span class="separator">' + c + '</span>'
 : '<span class="digit-wrapper"><span class="digit-content">' + DIGIT_STRIP + '</span></span>';
 }
 return html;
 }

 function extractDigits(s) {
 const arr = [];
 for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
 const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
 if (c>= 48 && c <= 57) arr.push(c - 48);
 }
 return arr;
 }

 function animateUp(digit, newNum) {
 let pos = digit._pos;
 const shown = pos % 10;
 if (shown === newNum) return;

 if (pos>= 10) {
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 pos = shown;
 digit._pos = pos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (pos * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 }

 const newPos = pos + ((newNum - shown + 10) % 10);
 digit._pos = newPos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (newPos * -1.2) + 'em)';

 if (newPos>= 10) {
 digit.addEventListener('transitionend', function snap(e) {
 if (e.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
 digit.removeEventListener('transitionend', snap);
 if (digit._pos !== newPos) return;
 const snapped = newPos - 10;
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 digit._pos = snapped;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (snapped * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 });
 }
 }

 function render() {
 const f = format(currentValue);
 if (f === lastFormatted) return;

 const newDigits = extractDigits(f);
 const oldDigits = extractDigits(lastFormatted);
 const firstRender = !digitElements;
 const structureChanged = newDigits.length !== oldDigits.length;

 if (firstRender || structureChanged) {
 const diff = newDigits.length - oldDigits.length;
 counterEl.innerHTML = buildHTML(f);
 digitElements = counterEl.querySelectorAll('.digit-content');

 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 const d = digitElements[i];
 let init = 0;
 if (!firstRender) {
 const oi = i - diff;
 if (oi>= 0 && oi < oldDigits.length) init = oldDigits[oi];
 }
 d._pos = init;
 d.style.transition = 'none';
 d.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (init * -1.2) + 'em)';
 }

 void counterEl.offsetHeight;

 requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 digitElements[i].style.transition = '';
 animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 });
 } else {
 for (let i = 0, len = newDigits.length; i < len; i++) {
 if (newDigits[i] !== oldDigits[i]) animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 }

 lastFormatted = f;
 }

 load();
 render();

 setInterval(() => {
 currentValue += clicksAtSecond(secondsSinceMidnight());
 render();
 if (++saveTickCounter>= SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS) {
 saveTickCounter = 0;
 save();
 }
 }, 1000);

 addEventListener('pagehide', save);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
 if (document.hidden) save();
 });
 }

 if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
 } else {
 init();
 }
})();
</script>

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const tooltipIcon = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16"><path d="M8 0a8 8 0 1 0 8 8 8.024 8.024 0 0 0-8-8m0 14a6 6 0 1 1 6-6 6.018 6.018 0 0 1-6 6"/><rect width="2" height="5" x="7" y="7" rx=".5"/><circle cx="8" cy="5" r="1"/></svg>
    `;

    function cleanCssString(value) {
        return value
            .trim()
            .replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
            .replace(/\\"/g, '"')
            .replace(/\\'/g, "'");
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item').forEach(function (item, index) {
        if (item.querySelector('.jc-tooltip-trigger')) {
            return;
        }

        const rawTooltip = getComputedStyle(item).getPropertyValue('--jc-tooltip');

        if (!rawTooltip || !rawTooltip.trim()) {
            return;
        }

        const tooltipText = cleanCssString(rawTooltip);
        const textElement = item.querySelector('.elementor-icon-list-text');

        if (!textElement || !tooltipText) {
            return;
        }

        const button = document.createElement('button');
        const tooltipId = 'jc-tooltip-' + index + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'jc-tooltip-trigger';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Más información');
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        button.setAttribute('aria-describedby', tooltipId);

        button.innerHTML = tooltipIcon + `<span class="jc-tooltip-bubble" id="${tooltipId}" role="tooltip">${tooltipText}</span>`;

        textElement.appendChild(button);

        button.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();

            const isOpen = button.classList.toggle('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function () {
        document.querySelectorAll('.jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open').forEach(function (button) {
            button.classList.remove('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key !== 'Escape') {
            return;
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open').forEach(function (button) {
            button.classList.remove('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    });
});
</script>

/* ==========================================================
   Joinchat Tooltip List
   Añadir clase al widget Elementor: joinchat-tooltip-list
   ========================================================== */

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-widget-container,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-items {
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item {
    position: relative;
}

/* Alineación del texto, iconos inline e icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text img {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Botón del icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    min-width: 16px;

    margin-left: 4px;
    padding: 0;

    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: #1e1e1e;

    cursor: help;
    line-height: 1;
    appearance: none;

    opacity: 0.65;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg {
    display: block;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg [fill] {
    fill: currentColor;
}

/* Estado focus accesible */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid currentColor;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Tooltip centrado respecto al icono */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    bottom: calc(100% + 9px);

    width: max-content;
    max-width: min(230px, 85vw);

    background: #1e1e1e;
    color: #ffffff;

    padding: 7px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-align: left;

    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);

    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;

    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);
    transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        transform 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s ease;

    z-index: 9999;
    white-space: normal;
}

/* Flechita centrada */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    top: 100%;

    transform: translateX(-50%);

    border-width: 6px 6px 0 6px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #1e1e1e transparent transparent transparent;
}

/* Mostrar en escritorio con hover/focus y en móvil con clase JS */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 1 activa
   Tooltip más estrecho, más alto si lo necesita,
   manteniendo posición relativa al icono
   ========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
        width: 220px;
        max-width: 70vw;
        min-height: 52px;

        padding: 9px 11px;

        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;

        white-space: normal;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 2 alternativa
   Usar solo si en móvil el tooltip se sigue saliendo
   por estar el icono demasiado cerca del borde.

   Para activarla:
   1. Descomenta este bloque.
   2. Comenta o elimina la Variante móvil 1 anterior.
   ========================================================== */

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const minInstalaciones = 739456;
    const maxInstalaciones = 748204;

    // Fecha actual en UTC (timezone 0)
    const fechaHoy = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // Genera una cifra reproducible para cada día
    let hash = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < fechaHoy.length; i++) {
        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + fechaHoy.charCodeAt(i);
        hash |= 0;
    }

    const rango = maxInstalaciones - minInstalaciones + 1;

    const instalacionesActuales =
        minInstalaciones + (Math.abs(hash) % rango);

    // Actualiza todos los elementos con class="activeinstalls"
    document
        .querySelectorAll('.activeinstalls')
        .forEach(function(el) {
            el.innerText =
                instalacionesActuales.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        });

    // Contador principal animado
    const elSpan = document.getElementById('instalaciones');

    if (!elSpan) return;

    let instalacionesMostradas = 0;

    function actualizarInstalaciones() {
        const incremento = Math.ceil(instalacionesActuales / 100);

        if (instalacionesMostradas < instalacionesActuales) {
            instalacionesMostradas = Math.min(
                instalacionesMostradas + incremento,
                instalacionesActuales
            );

            elSpan.innerText =
                instalacionesMostradas.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        } else {
            clearInterval(animarInstalaciones);
        }
    }

    const animarInstalaciones =
        setInterval(actualizarInstalaciones, 20);
});
</script>
<script>
(() => {
 'use strict';

 function init() {
 const counterEl = document.getElementById('counter');
 if (!counterEl) return;

 const BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND = (793566 * 6) / 86400;
 const STORAGE_KEY = 'joinchat_counter_data';
 const SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS = 10;

 const TIME_MULTIPLIERS = [
 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3,
 0.8, 0.8, 0.8,
 1.3, 1.3, 1.3,
 1.2, 1.2,
 0.9, 0.9, 0.9,
 1.4, 1.4, 1.4,
 1.1, 1.1,
 0.6, 0.6
 ];

 let strip = '';
 for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++)
 for (let d = 0; d < 10; d++)
 strip += '<span class="digit-inner">' + d + '</span>';
 const DIGIT_STRIP = strip;

 let currentValue = 0;
 let lastFormatted = '';
 let digitElements = null;
 let saveTickCounter = 0;
 let cachedMidnight = 0;
 let cachedMidnightDay = -1;

 function getMidnightUTC() {
 const now = new Date();
 const day = now.getUTCDate();
 if (day !== cachedMidnightDay) {
 cachedMidnight = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), day);
 cachedMidnightDay = day;
 }
 return cachedMidnight;
 }

 function secondsSinceMidnight() {
 return (Date.now() - getMidnightUTC()) / 1000 | 0;
 }

 function clicksAtSecond(s) {
 const h = (s / 3600) | 0;
 const base = BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND * TIME_MULTIPLIERS[h];
 const x = Math.sin(s) * 10000;
 const noise = x - Math.floor(x);
 const v = base + (noise - 0.5) * 0.6 * base;
 return v < 0 ? 0 : v;
 }

 function accumulatedClicks(seconds) {
 let total = 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < seconds; i++) total += clicksAtSecond(i);
 return total;
 }

 function load() {
 const midnight = getMidnightUTC();
 const now = Date.now();
 const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

 if (stored) {
 try {
 const d = JSON.parse(stored);
 if (d.midnightTimestamp === midnight) {
 currentValue = d.value;
 const elapsed = ((now - d.lastUpdateTime) / 1000) | 0;
 if (elapsed> 0) {
 const start = ((d.lastUpdateTime - midnight) / 1000) | 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < elapsed; i++) currentValue += clicksAtSecond(start + i);
 }
 save();
 return;
 }
 } catch (_) {}
 }

 currentValue = accumulatedClicks(secondsSinceMidnight());
 save();
 }

 function save() {
 localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
 value: currentValue,
 lastUpdateTime: Date.now(),
 midnightTimestamp: getMidnightUTC()
 }));
 }

 function format(n) {
 return Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('es-ES');
 }

 function buildHTML(value) {
 let html = '';
 for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
 const c = value[i];
 html += (c === ',' || c === '.')
 ? '<span class="separator">' + c + '</span>'
 : '<span class="digit-wrapper"><span class="digit-content">' + DIGIT_STRIP + '</span></span>';
 }
 return html;
 }

 function extractDigits(s) {
 const arr = [];
 for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
 const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
 if (c>= 48 && c <= 57) arr.push(c - 48);
 }
 return arr;
 }

 function animateUp(digit, newNum) {
 let pos = digit._pos;
 const shown = pos % 10;
 if (shown === newNum) return;

 if (pos>= 10) {
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 pos = shown;
 digit._pos = pos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (pos * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 }

 const newPos = pos + ((newNum - shown + 10) % 10);
 digit._pos = newPos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (newPos * -1.2) + 'em)';

 if (newPos>= 10) {
 digit.addEventListener('transitionend', function snap(e) {
 if (e.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
 digit.removeEventListener('transitionend', snap);
 if (digit._pos !== newPos) return;
 const snapped = newPos - 10;
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 digit._pos = snapped;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (snapped * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 });
 }
 }

 function render() {
 const f = format(currentValue);
 if (f === lastFormatted) return;

 const newDigits = extractDigits(f);
 const oldDigits = extractDigits(lastFormatted);
 const firstRender = !digitElements;
 const structureChanged = newDigits.length !== oldDigits.length;

 if (firstRender || structureChanged) {
 const diff = newDigits.length - oldDigits.length;
 counterEl.innerHTML = buildHTML(f);
 digitElements = counterEl.querySelectorAll('.digit-content');

 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 const d = digitElements[i];
 let init = 0;
 if (!firstRender) {
 const oi = i - diff;
 if (oi>= 0 && oi < oldDigits.length) init = oldDigits[oi];
 }
 d._pos = init;
 d.style.transition = 'none';
 d.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (init * -1.2) + 'em)';
 }

 void counterEl.offsetHeight;

 requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 digitElements[i].style.transition = '';
 animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 });
 } else {
 for (let i = 0, len = newDigits.length; i < len; i++) {
 if (newDigits[i] !== oldDigits[i]) animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 }

 lastFormatted = f;
 }

 load();
 render();

 setInterval(() => {
 currentValue += clicksAtSecond(secondsSinceMidnight());
 render();
 if (++saveTickCounter>= SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS) {
 saveTickCounter = 0;
 save();
 }
 }, 1000);

 addEventListener('pagehide', save);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
 if (document.hidden) save();
 });
 }

 if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
 } else {
 init();
 }
})();

/* ==========================================================
   Joinchat Tooltip List
   Añadir clase al widget Elementor: joinchat-tooltip-list
   ========================================================== */

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-widget-container,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-items {
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item {
    position: relative;
}

/* Alineación del texto, iconos inline e icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text img {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Botón del icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    min-width: 16px;

    margin-left: 4px;
    padding: 0;

    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: #1e1e1e;

    cursor: help;
    line-height: 1;
    appearance: none;

    opacity: 0.65;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg {
    display: block;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg [fill] {
    fill: currentColor;
}

/* Estado focus accesible */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid currentColor;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Tooltip centrado respecto al icono */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    bottom: calc(100% + 9px);

    width: max-content;
    max-width: min(230px, 85vw);

    background: #1e1e1e;
    color: #ffffff;

    padding: 7px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-align: left;

    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);

    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;

    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);
    transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        transform 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s ease;

    z-index: 9999;
    white-space: normal;
}

/* Flechita centrada */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    top: 100%;

    transform: translateX(-50%);

    border-width: 6px 6px 0 6px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #1e1e1e transparent transparent transparent;
}

/* Mostrar en escritorio con hover/focus y en móvil con clase JS */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 1 activa
   Tooltip más estrecho, más alto si lo necesita,
   manteniendo posición relativa al icono
   ========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
        width: 220px;
        max-width: 70vw;
        min-height: 52px;

        padding: 9px 11px;

        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;

        white-space: normal;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }
}

   por estar el icono demasiado cerca del borde.

					const events = [
						'DOMContentLoaded',
						'elementor/lazyload/observe',

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const minInstalaciones = 739456;
    const maxInstalaciones = 748204;

    // Fecha actual en UTC (timezone 0)
    const fechaHoy = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // Genera una cifra reproducible para cada día
    let hash = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < fechaHoy.length; i++) {
        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + fechaHoy.charCodeAt(i);
        hash |= 0;
    }

    const rango = maxInstalaciones - minInstalaciones + 1;

    const instalacionesActuales =
        minInstalaciones + (Math.abs(hash) % rango);

    // Actualiza todos los elementos con class="activeinstalls"
    document
        .querySelectorAll('.activeinstalls')
        .forEach(function(el) {
            el.innerText =
                instalacionesActuales.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        });

    // Contador principal animado
    const elSpan = document.getElementById('instalaciones');

    if (!elSpan) return;

    let instalacionesMostradas = 0;

    function actualizarInstalaciones() {
        const incremento = Math.ceil(instalacionesActuales / 100);

        if (instalacionesMostradas < instalacionesActuales) {
            instalacionesMostradas = Math.min(
                instalacionesMostradas + incremento,
                instalacionesActuales
            );

            elSpan.innerText =
                instalacionesMostradas.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        } else {
            clearInterval(animarInstalaciones);
        }
    }

    const animarInstalaciones =
        setInterval(actualizarInstalaciones, 20);
});
</script>
<script>
(() => {
 'use strict';

 function init() {
 const counterEl = document.getElementById('counter');
 if (!counterEl) return;

 const BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND = (793566 * 6) / 86400;
 const STORAGE_KEY = 'joinchat_counter_data';
 const SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS = 10;

 const TIME_MULTIPLIERS = [
 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3,
 0.8, 0.8, 0.8,
 1.3, 1.3, 1.3,
 1.2, 1.2,
 0.9, 0.9, 0.9,
 1.4, 1.4, 1.4,
 1.1, 1.1,
 0.6, 0.6
 ];

 let strip = '';
 for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++)
 for (let d = 0; d < 10; d++)
 strip += '<span class="digit-inner">' + d + '</span>';
 const DIGIT_STRIP = strip;

 let currentValue = 0;
 let lastFormatted = '';
 let digitElements = null;
 let saveTickCounter = 0;
 let cachedMidnight = 0;
 let cachedMidnightDay = -1;

 function getMidnightUTC() {
 const now = new Date();
 const day = now.getUTCDate();
 if (day !== cachedMidnightDay) {
 cachedMidnight = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), day);
 cachedMidnightDay = day;
 }
 return cachedMidnight;
 }

 function secondsSinceMidnight() {
 return (Date.now() - getMidnightUTC()) / 1000 | 0;
 }

 function clicksAtSecond(s) {
 const h = (s / 3600) | 0;
 const base = BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND * TIME_MULTIPLIERS[h];
 const x = Math.sin(s) * 10000;
 const noise = x - Math.floor(x);
 const v = base + (noise - 0.5) * 0.6 * base;
 return v < 0 ? 0 : v;
 }

 function accumulatedClicks(seconds) {
 let total = 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < seconds; i++) total += clicksAtSecond(i);
 return total;
 }

 function load() {
 const midnight = getMidnightUTC();
 const now = Date.now();
 const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

 if (stored) {
 try {
 const d = JSON.parse(stored);
 if (d.midnightTimestamp === midnight) {
 currentValue = d.value;
 const elapsed = ((now - d.lastUpdateTime) / 1000) | 0;
 if (elapsed> 0) {
 const start = ((d.lastUpdateTime - midnight) / 1000) | 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < elapsed; i++) currentValue += clicksAtSecond(start + i);
 }
 save();
 return;
 }
 } catch (_) {}
 }

 currentValue = accumulatedClicks(secondsSinceMidnight());
 save();
 }

 function save() {
 localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
 value: currentValue,
 lastUpdateTime: Date.now(),
 midnightTimestamp: getMidnightUTC()
 }));
 }

 function format(n) {
 return Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('es-ES');
 }

 function buildHTML(value) {
 let html = '';
 for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
 const c = value[i];
 html += (c === ',' || c === '.')
 ? '<span class="separator">' + c + '</span>'
 : '<span class="digit-wrapper"><span class="digit-content">' + DIGIT_STRIP + '</span></span>';
 }
 return html;
 }

 function extractDigits(s) {
 const arr = [];
 for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
 const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
 if (c>= 48 && c <= 57) arr.push(c - 48);
 }
 return arr;
 }

 function animateUp(digit, newNum) {
 let pos = digit._pos;
 const shown = pos % 10;
 if (shown === newNum) return;

 if (pos>= 10) {
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 pos = shown;
 digit._pos = pos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (pos * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 }

 const newPos = pos + ((newNum - shown + 10) % 10);
 digit._pos = newPos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (newPos * -1.2) + 'em)';

 if (newPos>= 10) {
 digit.addEventListener('transitionend', function snap(e) {
 if (e.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
 digit.removeEventListener('transitionend', snap);
 if (digit._pos !== newPos) return;
 const snapped = newPos - 10;
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 digit._pos = snapped;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (snapped * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 });
 }
 }

 function render() {
 const f = format(currentValue);
 if (f === lastFormatted) return;

 const newDigits = extractDigits(f);
 const oldDigits = extractDigits(lastFormatted);
 const firstRender = !digitElements;
 const structureChanged = newDigits.length !== oldDigits.length;

 if (firstRender || structureChanged) {
 const diff = newDigits.length - oldDigits.length;
 counterEl.innerHTML = buildHTML(f);
 digitElements = counterEl.querySelectorAll('.digit-content');

 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 const d = digitElements[i];
 let init = 0;
 if (!firstRender) {
 const oi = i - diff;
 if (oi>= 0 && oi < oldDigits.length) init = oldDigits[oi];
 }
 d._pos = init;
 d.style.transition = 'none';
 d.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (init * -1.2) + 'em)';
 }

 void counterEl.offsetHeight;

 requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 digitElements[i].style.transition = '';
 animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 });
 } else {
 for (let i = 0, len = newDigits.length; i < len; i++) {
 if (newDigits[i] !== oldDigits[i]) animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 }

 lastFormatted = f;
 }

 load();
 render();

 setInterval(() => {
 currentValue += clicksAtSecond(secondsSinceMidnight());
 render();
 if (++saveTickCounter>= SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS) {
 saveTickCounter = 0;
 save();
 }
 }, 1000);

 addEventListener('pagehide', save);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
 if (document.hidden) save();
 });
 }

 if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
 } else {
 init();
 }
})();
</script>

    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function () {
        document.querySelectorAll('.jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open').forEach(function (button) {

            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    });
});

/* ==========================================================
   Joinchat Tooltip List
   Añadir clase al widget Elementor: joinchat-tooltip-list
   ========================================================== */

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-widget-container,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-items {
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item {
    position: relative;
}

/* Alineación del texto, iconos inline e icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text img {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Botón del icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    min-width: 16px;

    margin-left: 4px;
    padding: 0;

    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: #1e1e1e;

    cursor: help;
    line-height: 1;
    appearance: none;

    opacity: 0.65;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg {
    display: block;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg [fill] {
    fill: currentColor;
}

/* Estado focus accesible */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid currentColor;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Tooltip centrado respecto al icono */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    bottom: calc(100% + 9px);

    width: max-content;
    max-width: min(230px, 85vw);

    background: #1e1e1e;
    color: #ffffff;

    padding: 7px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-align: left;

    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);

    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;

    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);
    transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        transform 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s ease;

    z-index: 9999;
    white-space: normal;
}

/* Flechita centrada */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    top: 100%;

    transform: translateX(-50%);

    border-width: 6px 6px 0 6px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #1e1e1e transparent transparent transparent;
}

/* Mostrar en escritorio con hover/focus y en móvil con clase JS */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 1 activa
   Tooltip más estrecho, más alto si lo necesita,
   manteniendo posición relativa al icono
   ========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 767px) {
    .joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
        width: 220px;
        max-width: 70vw;
        min-height: 52px;

        padding: 9px 11px;

        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 1.4;

        white-space: normal;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
    }
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 2 alternativa
   Usar solo si en móvil el tooltip se sigue saliendo
   por estar el icono demasiado cerca del borde.

   Para activarla:
   1. Descomenta este bloque.
   2. Comenta o elimina la Variante móvil 1 anterior.
   ========================================================== */

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const minInstalaciones = 739456;
    const maxInstalaciones = 748204;

    // Fecha actual en UTC (timezone 0)
    const fechaHoy = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // Genera una cifra reproducible para cada día
    let hash = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < fechaHoy.length; i++) {
        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + fechaHoy.charCodeAt(i);
        hash |= 0;
    }

    const rango = maxInstalaciones - minInstalaciones + 1;

    const instalacionesActuales =
        minInstalaciones + (Math.abs(hash) % rango);

    // Actualiza todos los elementos con class="activeinstalls"
    document
        .querySelectorAll('.activeinstalls')
        .forEach(function(el) {
            el.innerText =
                instalacionesActuales.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        });

    // Contador principal animado
    const elSpan = document.getElementById('instalaciones');

    if (!elSpan) return;

    let instalacionesMostradas = 0;

    function actualizarInstalaciones() {
        const incremento = Math.ceil(instalacionesActuales / 100);

        if (instalacionesMostradas < instalacionesActuales) {
            instalacionesMostradas = Math.min(
                instalacionesMostradas + incremento,
                instalacionesActuales
            );

            elSpan.innerText =
                instalacionesMostradas.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        } else {
            clearInterval(animarInstalaciones);
        }
    }

    const animarInstalaciones =
        setInterval(actualizarInstalaciones, 20);
});
</script>
<script>
(() => {
 'use strict';

 function init() {
 const counterEl = document.getElementById('counter');
 if (!counterEl) return;

 const BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND = (793566 * 6) / 86400;
 const STORAGE_KEY = 'joinchat_counter_data';
 const SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS = 10;

 const TIME_MULTIPLIERS = [
 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3,
 0.8, 0.8, 0.8,
 1.3, 1.3, 1.3,
 1.2, 1.2,
 0.9, 0.9, 0.9,
 1.4, 1.4, 1.4,
 1.1, 1.1,
 0.6, 0.6
 ];

 let strip = '';
 for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++)
 for (let d = 0; d < 10; d++)
 strip += '<span class="digit-inner">' + d + '</span>';
 const DIGIT_STRIP = strip;

 let currentValue = 0;
 let lastFormatted = '';
 let digitElements = null;
 let saveTickCounter = 0;
 let cachedMidnight = 0;
 let cachedMidnightDay = -1;

 function getMidnightUTC() {
 const now = new Date();
 const day = now.getUTCDate();
 if (day !== cachedMidnightDay) {
 cachedMidnight = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), day);
 cachedMidnightDay = day;
 }
 return cachedMidnight;
 }

 function secondsSinceMidnight() {
 return (Date.now() - getMidnightUTC()) / 1000 | 0;
 }

 function clicksAtSecond(s) {
 const h = (s / 3600) | 0;
 const base = BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND * TIME_MULTIPLIERS[h];
 const x = Math.sin(s) * 10000;
 const noise = x - Math.floor(x);
 const v = base + (noise - 0.5) * 0.6 * base;
 return v < 0 ? 0 : v;
 }

 function accumulatedClicks(seconds) {
 let total = 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < seconds; i++) total += clicksAtSecond(i);
 return total;
 }

 function load() {
 const midnight = getMidnightUTC();
 const now = Date.now();
 const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

 if (stored) {
 try {
 const d = JSON.parse(stored);
 if (d.midnightTimestamp === midnight) {
 currentValue = d.value;
 const elapsed = ((now - d.lastUpdateTime) / 1000) | 0;
 if (elapsed> 0) {
 const start = ((d.lastUpdateTime - midnight) / 1000) | 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < elapsed; i++) currentValue += clicksAtSecond(start + i);
 }
 save();
 return;
 }
 } catch (_) {}
 }

 currentValue = accumulatedClicks(secondsSinceMidnight());
 save();
 }

 function save() {
 localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
 value: currentValue,
 lastUpdateTime: Date.now(),
 midnightTimestamp: getMidnightUTC()
 }));
 }

 function format(n) {
 return Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('es-ES');
 }

 function buildHTML(value) {
 let html = '';
 for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
 const c = value[i];
 html += (c === ',' || c === '.')
 ? '<span class="separator">' + c + '</span>'
 : '<span class="digit-wrapper"><span class="digit-content">' + DIGIT_STRIP + '</span></span>';
 }
 return html;
 }

 function extractDigits(s) {
 const arr = [];
 for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
 const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
 if (c>= 48 && c <= 57) arr.push(c - 48);
 }
 return arr;
 }

 function animateUp(digit, newNum) {
 let pos = digit._pos;
 const shown = pos % 10;
 if (shown === newNum) return;

 if (pos>= 10) {
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 pos = shown;
 digit._pos = pos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (pos * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 }

 const newPos = pos + ((newNum - shown + 10) % 10);
 digit._pos = newPos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (newPos * -1.2) + 'em)';

 if (newPos>= 10) {
 digit.addEventListener('transitionend', function snap(e) {
 if (e.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
 digit.removeEventListener('transitionend', snap);
 if (digit._pos !== newPos) return;
 const snapped = newPos - 10;
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 digit._pos = snapped;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (snapped * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 });
 }
 }

 function render() {
 const f = format(currentValue);
 if (f === lastFormatted) return;

 const newDigits = extractDigits(f);
 const oldDigits = extractDigits(lastFormatted);
 const firstRender = !digitElements;
 const structureChanged = newDigits.length !== oldDigits.length;

 if (firstRender || structureChanged) {
 const diff = newDigits.length - oldDigits.length;
 counterEl.innerHTML = buildHTML(f);
 digitElements = counterEl.querySelectorAll('.digit-content');

 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 const d = digitElements[i];
 let init = 0;
 if (!firstRender) {
 const oi = i - diff;
 if (oi>= 0 && oi < oldDigits.length) init = oldDigits[oi];
 }
 d._pos = init;
 d.style.transition = 'none';
 d.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (init * -1.2) + 'em)';
 }

 void counterEl.offsetHeight;

 requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 digitElements[i].style.transition = '';
 animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 });
 } else {
 for (let i = 0, len = newDigits.length; i < len; i++) {
 if (newDigits[i] !== oldDigits[i]) animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 }

 lastFormatted = f;
 }

 load();
 render();

 setInterval(() => {
 currentValue += clicksAtSecond(secondsSinceMidnight());
 render();
 if (++saveTickCounter>= SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS) {
 saveTickCounter = 0;
 save();
 }
 }, 1000);

 addEventListener('pagehide', save);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
 if (document.hidden) save();
 });
 }

 if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
 } else {
 init();
 }
})();
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const tooltipIcon = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16"><path d="M8 0a8 8 0 1 0 8 8 8.024 8.024 0 0 0-8-8m0 14a6 6 0 1 1 6-6 6.018 6.018 0 0 1-6 6"/><rect width="2" height="5" x="7" y="7" rx=".5"/><circle cx="8" cy="5" r="1"/></svg>
    `;

    function cleanCssString(value) {
        return value
            .trim()
            .replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
            .replace(/\\"/g, '"')
            .replace(/\\'/g, "'");
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item').forEach(function (item, index) {
        if (item.querySelector('.jc-tooltip-trigger')) {
            return;
        }

        const rawTooltip = getComputedStyle(item).getPropertyValue('--jc-tooltip');

        if (!rawTooltip || !rawTooltip.trim()) {
            return;
        }

        const tooltipText = cleanCssString(rawTooltip);
        const textElement = item.querySelector('.elementor-icon-list-text');

        if (!textElement || !tooltipText) {
            return;
        }

        const button = document.createElement('button');
        const tooltipId = 'jc-tooltip-' + index + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'jc-tooltip-trigger';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Más información');
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        button.setAttribute('aria-describedby', tooltipId);

        button.innerHTML = tooltipIcon + `<span class="jc-tooltip-bubble" id="${tooltipId}" role="tooltip">${tooltipText}</span>`;

        textElement.appendChild(button);

        button.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();

            const isOpen = button.classList.toggle('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function () {
        document.querySelectorAll('.jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open').forEach(function (button) {
            button.classList.remove('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key !== 'Escape') {
            return;
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open').forEach(function (button) {
            button.classList.remove('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    });
});
</script>

/* ==========================================================
   Joinchat Tooltip List
   Añadir clase al widget Elementor: joinchat-tooltip-list
   ========================================================== */

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-widget-container,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-items {
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item {
    position: relative;
}

/* Alineación del texto, iconos inline e icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    overflow: visible;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-text img {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    display: inline-block;
    vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Botón del icono info */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    min-width: 16px;

    margin-left: 4px;
    padding: 0;

    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    color: #1e1e1e;

    cursor: help;
    line-height: 1;
    appearance: none;

    opacity: 0.65;
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open {
    opacity: 1;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg {
    display: block;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
}

.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger svg [fill] {
    fill: currentColor;
}

/* Estado focus accesible */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid currentColor;
    outline-offset: 2px;
    border-radius: 3px;
}

/* Tooltip centrado respecto al icono */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    bottom: calc(100% + 9px);

    width: max-content;
    max-width: min(230px, 85vw);

    background: #1e1e1e;
    color: #ffffff;

    padding: 7px 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;

    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.35;
    font-weight: 400;
    text-align: left;

    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);

    opacity: 0;
    visibility: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;

    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);
    transition:
        opacity 0.15s ease,
        transform 0.15s ease,
        visibility 0.15s ease;

    z-index: 9999;
    white-space: normal;
}

/* Flechita centrada */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-bubble::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;

    left: 50%;
    right: auto;
    top: 100%;

    transform: translateX(-50%);

    border-width: 6px 6px 0 6px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #1e1e1e transparent transparent transparent;
}

/* Mostrar en escritorio con hover/focus y en móvil con clase JS */
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:hover .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger:focus-visible .jc-tooltip-bubble,
.joinchat-tooltip-list .jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open .jc-tooltip-bubble {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

/* ==========================================================
   Variante móvil 1 activa
   Tooltip más estrecho, más alto si lo necesita,
   manteniendo posición relativa al icono
   ========================================================== */

@media (max-width: 767px) {

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const minInstalaciones = 739456;
    const maxInstalaciones = 748204;

    // Fecha actual en UTC (timezone 0)
    const fechaHoy = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // Genera una cifra reproducible para cada día
    let hash = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < fechaHoy.length; i++) {
        hash = ((hash << 5) - hash) + fechaHoy.charCodeAt(i);
        hash |= 0;
    }

    const rango = maxInstalaciones - minInstalaciones + 1;

    const instalacionesActuales =
        minInstalaciones + (Math.abs(hash) % rango);

    // Actualiza todos los elementos con class="activeinstalls"
    document
        .querySelectorAll('.activeinstalls')
        .forEach(function(el) {
            el.innerText =
                instalacionesActuales.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        });

    // Contador principal animado
    const elSpan = document.getElementById('instalaciones');

    if (!elSpan) return;

    let instalacionesMostradas = 0;

    function actualizarInstalaciones() {
        const incremento = Math.ceil(instalacionesActuales / 100);

        if (instalacionesMostradas < instalacionesActuales) {
            instalacionesMostradas = Math.min(
                instalacionesMostradas + incremento,
                instalacionesActuales
            );

            elSpan.innerText =
                instalacionesMostradas.toLocaleString('es-ES');
        } else {
            clearInterval(animarInstalaciones);
        }
    }

    const animarInstalaciones =
        setInterval(actualizarInstalaciones, 20);
});
</script>
<script>
(() => {
 'use strict';

 function init() {
 const counterEl = document.getElementById('counter');
 if (!counterEl) return;

 const BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND = (793566 * 6) / 86400;
 const STORAGE_KEY = 'joinchat_counter_data';
 const SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS = 10;

 const TIME_MULTIPLIERS = [
 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3,
 0.8, 0.8, 0.8,
 1.3, 1.3, 1.3,
 1.2, 1.2,
 0.9, 0.9, 0.9,
 1.4, 1.4, 1.4,
 1.1, 1.1,
 0.6, 0.6
 ];

 let strip = '';
 for (let c = 0; c < 2; c++)
 for (let d = 0; d < 10; d++)
 strip += '<span class="digit-inner">' + d + '</span>';
 const DIGIT_STRIP = strip;

 let currentValue = 0;
 let lastFormatted = '';
 let digitElements = null;
 let saveTickCounter = 0;
 let cachedMidnight = 0;
 let cachedMidnightDay = -1;

 function getMidnightUTC() {
 const now = new Date();
 const day = now.getUTCDate();
 if (day !== cachedMidnightDay) {
 cachedMidnight = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), day);
 cachedMidnightDay = day;
 }
 return cachedMidnight;
 }

 function secondsSinceMidnight() {
 return (Date.now() - getMidnightUTC()) / 1000 | 0;
 }

 function clicksAtSecond(s) {
 const h = (s / 3600) | 0;
 const base = BASE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND * TIME_MULTIPLIERS[h];
 const x = Math.sin(s) * 10000;
 const noise = x - Math.floor(x);
 const v = base + (noise - 0.5) * 0.6 * base;
 return v < 0 ? 0 : v;
 }

 function accumulatedClicks(seconds) {
 let total = 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < seconds; i++) total += clicksAtSecond(i);
 return total;
 }

 function load() {
 const midnight = getMidnightUTC();
 const now = Date.now();
 const stored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

 if (stored) {
 try {
 const d = JSON.parse(stored);
 if (d.midnightTimestamp === midnight) {
 currentValue = d.value;
 const elapsed = ((now - d.lastUpdateTime) / 1000) | 0;
 if (elapsed> 0) {
 const start = ((d.lastUpdateTime - midnight) / 1000) | 0;
 for (let i = 0; i < elapsed; i++) currentValue += clicksAtSecond(start + i);
 }
 save();
 return;
 }
 } catch (_) {}
 }

 currentValue = accumulatedClicks(secondsSinceMidnight());
 save();
 }

 function save() {
 localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({
 value: currentValue,
 lastUpdateTime: Date.now(),
 midnightTimestamp: getMidnightUTC()
 }));
 }

 function format(n) {
 return Math.floor(n).toLocaleString('es-ES');
 }

 function buildHTML(value) {
 let html = '';
 for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i++) {
 const c = value[i];
 html += (c === ',' || c === '.')
 ? '<span class="separator">' + c + '</span>'
 : '<span class="digit-wrapper"><span class="digit-content">' + DIGIT_STRIP + '</span></span>';
 }
 return html;
 }

 function extractDigits(s) {
 const arr = [];
 for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
 const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
 if (c>= 48 && c <= 57) arr.push(c - 48);
 }
 return arr;
 }

 function animateUp(digit, newNum) {
 let pos = digit._pos;
 const shown = pos % 10;
 if (shown === newNum) return;

 if (pos>= 10) {
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 pos = shown;
 digit._pos = pos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (pos * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 }

 const newPos = pos + ((newNum - shown + 10) % 10);
 digit._pos = newPos;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (newPos * -1.2) + 'em)';

 if (newPos>= 10) {
 digit.addEventListener('transitionend', function snap(e) {
 if (e.propertyName !== 'transform') return;
 digit.removeEventListener('transitionend', snap);
 if (digit._pos !== newPos) return;
 const snapped = newPos - 10;
 digit.style.transition = 'none';
 digit._pos = snapped;
 digit.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (snapped * -1.2) + 'em)';
 void digit.offsetHeight;
 digit.style.transition = '';
 });
 }
 }

 function render() {
 const f = format(currentValue);
 if (f === lastFormatted) return;

 const newDigits = extractDigits(f);
 const oldDigits = extractDigits(lastFormatted);
 const firstRender = !digitElements;
 const structureChanged = newDigits.length !== oldDigits.length;

 if (firstRender || structureChanged) {
 const diff = newDigits.length - oldDigits.length;
 counterEl.innerHTML = buildHTML(f);
 digitElements = counterEl.querySelectorAll('.digit-content');

 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 const d = digitElements[i];
 let init = 0;
 if (!firstRender) {
 const oi = i - diff;
 if (oi>= 0 && oi < oldDigits.length) init = oldDigits[oi];
 }
 d._pos = init;
 d.style.transition = 'none';
 d.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (init * -1.2) + 'em)';
 }

 void counterEl.offsetHeight;

 requestAnimationFrame(() => {
 for (let i = 0, len = digitElements.length; i < len; i++) {
 digitElements[i].style.transition = '';
 animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 });
 } else {
 for (let i = 0, len = newDigits.length; i < len; i++) {
 if (newDigits[i] !== oldDigits[i]) animateUp(digitElements[i], newDigits[i]);
 }
 }

 lastFormatted = f;
 }

 load();
 render();

 setInterval(() => {
 currentValue += clicksAtSecond(secondsSinceMidnight());
 render();
 if (++saveTickCounter>= SAVE_EVERY_N_TICKS) {
 saveTickCounter = 0;
 save();
 }
 }, 1000);

 addEventListener('pagehide', save);
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
 if (document.hidden) save();
 });
 }

 if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
 document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
 } else {
 init();
 }
})();
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const tooltipIcon = `
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16"><path d="M8 0a8 8 0 1 0 8 8 8.024 8.024 0 0 0-8-8m0 14a6 6 0 1 1 6-6 6.018 6.018 0 0 1-6 6"/><rect width="2" height="5" x="7" y="7" rx=".5"/><circle cx="8" cy="5" r="1"/></svg>
    `;

    function cleanCssString(value) {
        return value
            .trim()
            .replace(/^["']|["']$/g, '')
            .replace(/\\"/g, '"')
            .replace(/\\'/g, "'");
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('.joinchat-tooltip-list .elementor-icon-list-item').forEach(function (item, index) {
        if (item.querySelector('.jc-tooltip-trigger')) {
            return;
        }

        const rawTooltip = getComputedStyle(item).getPropertyValue('--jc-tooltip');

        if (!rawTooltip || !rawTooltip.trim()) {
            return;
        }

        const tooltipText = cleanCssString(rawTooltip);
        const textElement = item.querySelector('.elementor-icon-list-text');

        if (!textElement || !tooltipText) {
            return;
        }

        const button = document.createElement('button');
        const tooltipId = 'jc-tooltip-' + index + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8);

        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'jc-tooltip-trigger';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Más información');
        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        button.setAttribute('aria-describedby', tooltipId);

        button.innerHTML = tooltipIcon + `<span class="jc-tooltip-bubble" id="${tooltipId}" role="tooltip">${tooltipText}</span>`;

        textElement.appendChild(button);

        button.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopPropagation();

            const isOpen = button.classList.toggle('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function () {
        document.querySelectorAll('.jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open').forEach(function (button) {
            button.classList.remove('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
        if (event.key !== 'Escape') {
            return;
        }

        document.querySelectorAll('.jc-tooltip-trigger.is-open').forEach(function (button) {
            button.classList.remove('is-open');
            button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
    });
});
</script>
